title: Manchester United's Bassey Rumour Meets a Leaky Back Line
body:
Manchester United are reportedly interested in Fulham defender Calvin Bassey, according to BBC Sport's gossip column [S1]. The story matters because the club's recent form has been poor, and any defensive reinforcement would be a direct answer to that.

The same column links Brentford's Nathan Collins with a move and reports that AC Milan want Real Madrid's Endrick on loan [S1]. A separate BBC Sport round-up says Como midfielder Nico Paz is also on United's list, and that new head coach Mauricio Pochettino is set to have money to spend [S2].

The numbers explain the urgency. Across their last five league games, United have picked up three points from three draws and two defeats, scoring six and conceding eleven [ST1]. Fulham, by contrast, have eight points from two wins, two draws and one defeat, with five scored and four conceded [ST2].

Talk is cheap until the paperwork is signed, so treat every rumour with care.

The Touchline Take: judge the business when the window shuts, not before.
